items.caption: A seal-script form of 子 has a rounded upper enclosure and long descending strokes. It is a later reference form, distinct from the Shang infant-shaped forms described in paleographic accounts.
items.alt: Black seal-script strokes forming 子, with a rounded loop above a forked lower shape.
items.selection_reason: This identified seal-style form offers a useful visual reference alongside accounts interpreting Shang forms as an infant; it should not be read as an inscription or as proof of the graph’s original meaning.

limitations.text: The image is a modern digital redraw of a seal-script style, not a dated inscription image. The historical interpretation of 子 as an infant comes from paleographic analysis, and the specific anatomy remains interpretive.
